t_advice_summary_textbox.text: take breaks to avoid wrist strain as it will become quite monotonous. Red and blues make the most point, pinks the least.

vb_textbox.text: Make sure you take the full breaks to rest your wrists and eyes as the task does get monotonous and boring. You do start to make mistakes after a while. I don't think you earn more or less depending on which colour gnome you choose. It depends on the bonus in the middle. You need to click straight away when the gnomes come up so click before they even come up and again before the wood scene even comes up. Click when you see the screen with the grey background and the cross on so you aren't too slow
